notes.title: 2024.5.31 Updated
notes.content:
2024.5.31 Updated

1. New features --
This update adds the function of tower defense - (layout module) sliding, batch layout sword meaning (tower),
Also adjusted (layout module) the function of the back button.

Players can slide and drag the layout instead of clicking one by one.

2. Fixed a large number of bugs in the plot - about opening - hiding NPCS, such as NPC display error, NPC not open correctly, column lack of content and other issues have been fixed.

Fixed issues with a large number of blocks, stuck or delayed triggers, and also fixed issues with partial flash back, causing the archive to disappear.

3. Fixed various types of (close button) can not trigger correctly, or delay issues.
4. Optimized the music control button, unable to control the volume problem.
